hero.title: lkc.ultimate
hero.subtitle: Hi, I'm Likkan, a Sports Photographer based in Birmingham, UK.

about.title: About
about.body: I started playing Ultimate in 2021 and since 2023, I've been capturing the sport through photography. I cover events across the UK and Europe, including for the GB national teams.

featured.title: Featured Albums
featured.body: Take a look at my latest photos from the last few events.

contact.body: Feel free to reach out for collaborations, event coverage, or just to say hi! I'm always open to connecting with fellow Ultimate enthusiasts and photographers.
